headline: Binance CEO says 90 percent of stolen assets have been ‘replenished’
summary: Binance CEO reports 90% of $6.3 billion stolen crypto has been replaced. The company pledges to cover the remaining 10% of funds. This follows a record-breaking crypto heist from Binance customers.

summary: The author created their own AI 'Muse Charm' to preempt Meta's version. Meta's concept involves a cute, Tamagotchi-like AI helper. This DIY project offers an alternative to purchasing Meta's product.

summary: Discover the chronological reading order for the Redwall series. A guide helps navigate Brian Jacques' beloved fantasy world. Perfect for new readers and those revisiting Abbeywood.

summary: Joe Manganiello remains committed to bringing his Dragonlance TV series to life. The Dungeons & Dragons enthusiast hopes to revive the canceled project. Manganiello is a well-known D&D player in Hollywood.

headline: It: Welcome to Derry Drops Surprise Halloween Episode
summary: HBO released a surprise Halloween episode of 'It: Welcome to Derry'. The unexpected installment jump-starts holiday celebrations for subscribers. It expands the chilling universe of Stephen King's horror saga.

headline: 'We came back from hell', say Ukrainians after years in Russia-occupied front-line city
summary: Ukrainians recount harrowing escapes from a Russia-occupied front-line city. One couple described crossing minefields in Oleshky for food. Stories emerge of immense suffering and resilience after years of occupation.

headline: Laura Kuenssberg: Healey risks breaking minimum wage promise for younger workers
summary: Chancellor Healey suggests younger workers might not receive minimum wage parity. This potential policy shift could occur before the next election. Concerns are rising about a broken promise to young earners.

headline: Clashes erupt between police and protesters in Paris
summary: Over 320,000 people protested across France over living costs. Demonstrations targeted rising expenses and inadequate public services. Clashes with police were reported in Paris during a third weekend of protests.

headline: 'It's been killing me!' Celebrity Traitors winners relieved the secret is out
summary: Winners of 'Celebrity Traitors' express immense relief after the finale. The second series captivated 11.2 million live viewers. Keeping the secret of their victory was a heavy burden.
